title: Aureline M5 change-intent lifecycle-state record
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a change-intent lifecycle-state record. Names the object class, its change-intent association, the provider ownership, the local-versus-provider commit state (local draft, queued publish, provider linked, publish-failed-retained, provider-unavailable, offline-handoff-packet, or stale-relative-to-provider), the linked branch / worktree / review identity, the relation source (linked by provider, linked locally, suggested by Aureline, or stale-or-broken relation), and the retained local packet / linked evidence — so a change-intent surface never keeps a stale branch / review / provider relation green after drift is detected, no local draft or queued publish reads as a provider-committed update, and no local packet or linked evidence is dropped when a provider write fails. Downstream the start-work sheet, linked-change panel, work-item detail, help / docs, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a lifecycle state by hand. Secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
